paite: Abraham upa in ahong tek mahmahta a, TOUPA'N thil bangkim ah Abraham avualzawl hi.
heading: Isak Zineihna
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

paite: Abraham in asikha, a-inn a upapen, aneih tengteng tung a thuneipa kiang ah, "Hehpih in ka pheipi nuai ah na khut golh in,
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

paite: TOUPA, van Pathian leh lei Pathian min lou in, ka tenna Kanaan mite nungak lak a mi ka tapa zi ding a neihsak lou ding in, ka hon kichiamsak ding.
english: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

paite: Ka gam lam a ka tanaute kiang ah hoh inla, ka tapa Isak zi na pisak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

paite: Sikha in akiang ah, "Numei in hiai gam lam ah hon zui nuam kei taleh, na tapa na hong pawtna gam a pikik nawn ding ka hi diam?" achi hi.
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

paite: Abraham in akiang ah, "Huai a ka tapa pikik nawn lou ding in pilvang in.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

paite: TOUPA, van Pathian, ka pa inn a kipan leh ka pianna gam a kipan hon pikhepa leh hon houpihpa leh hiai gam na suante kiang ah ka pe ding, chi a ka kiang a kichiampa'n, amah ngei in na ma ah a-angel apaisak ding a, huai a kipan ka tapa zi na pisak ding ahi.
english: Yahweh, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

paite: Numei in hon zuih nop keileh, ka kiang a na kichiamna thu ah na siang ding. Akoi abang hitaleh, huai ah zaw ka tapa na pikik nawn ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

paite: Sikha in apu Abraham pheipi nuai ah akhut agolh a, akiang ah huai thu ah akichiamta hi.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

paite: Sikha in apu sangawngsaute lak ah sangawngsau sawm akai a, apu thil hoih chiteng tawi in, apawtkheta hi. Athou a, Mesopotamia gam a Nahor khopi lam ah akipankheta hi.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

paite: Nitaklam a tui tawi dia numeite akuan hun laitak un, dainawl a tuileh kiang ah asangawngsaute akhukdinsak hi.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, hehpih in tuni in hon lohchingsak in, ka pu Abraham tung ah hehpihna langsak in.
english: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

paite: En in, tuikhuk kiang ah ka dingh a, khua a mite tanute tui tawi ding in ahong kuan uhi.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

paite: Huan hichi hi henla, nungak kuapeuh kiang a, 'Hehpih in ka dawn ding in na tuibel niamsak dih ve,' ka chih a, ama'n, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding,' chi peuhmah, huai mi ngei na sikha Isak zi ding a na miseh hi hen. Hiai ah ka pu tung ah hehpihna na langsak, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, agen khit ma in, ngai in, Abraham nau Nahor zi Milkah tapa Bethuel tanu Rebekah, aliangzang a tuibel pua in ahong kuan hi.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

paite: Huai nungak amel hoih mahmah, nungak siangthou ahi a, pasal himhim akithuahpih ngei kei hi. Tuikhuk ah apaisuk a, atuibel adimsak a, apaitou nawn hi.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

paite: Amah tuak ding in sikhapa atai a, "Hehpih in na tuibel a tui tawmchik hon dawnsak dih ve,” achi hi.
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

paite: Ama'n, “Dawn in, ka toupa," achi a; kintak in akhut in atuibel adomkhesuk a, adawnsak hi.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

paite: Adawn nung in, "Na sangawngsaute a ding leng, adawnkham masiah uh ka tawi ding," achi hi.
english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

paite: Kintak in gankuang ah atuibel atei a, tui tawi ding in tuileh lam ah atai nawn a, asangawngsau tengteng a ding leng atawisak hi.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

paite: Sikha in alohchingsak leh sak louh theihna ding in adai dide hi.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hina, sangawngsaute'n adawnkhamtak un, sikha in dangka-eng bilbah shekel kimkhat a gik leh akhut a ding dangka-eng tau nih shekel sawm a gik asuahkhia hi.
english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

paite: Akiang ah, "Kua tanu na hia? Hehpih in hon hilh in. Na pa inn ah ka giahna ding uh mun a-om diam?" achi hi.
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethuel, Milkah tapa, Nahor a ding a aneih- saknu tanu ka hi," achi hi.
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

paite: Amah mah in akiang ah, "Buhpawl leh gan an ka hau tuak ua, giahna mun leng ka nei uh," achi hi.
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

paite: Sikha in alu akunsak a, TOUPA abia hi.
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

paite: "Ka pu tung ngei a azahngaihna leh athutakna tawp ngei lou, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian phat in om hen. Kei leng, TOUPA'N ka pu unaute inn lam a hon na pi ahi ve,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

paite: Nungak atai a, huai thute anu inkuanpihte ava hilh hi.
english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

paite: Rebekah in sanggam pasal anei a, amin Laban ahi. Laban apawtkhia a, tuikhuk lam ah huai mi kiang ah ava tai hi.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, bilbah leh asanggamnu khut a taute amu a, huai mi'n, "Huchi khachi in ahon chi," chi a, asanggamnu Rebekah thugente azaktak in, huai mi kiang ah ahohta hi. Ngai in, amah tuikhuk ah sangawngsaute kiang ah ana dingh gige hi.
english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

paite: Laban in, "Nang, TOUPA vualzawlpa, hong inla, ka inn uah hong lut in. Bangziak a inpua a dingh nilouh? Inn leh mun sangawngsaute a ding in ka bawl khinta," achi hi.
english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

paite: Huchi in inn ah alut a, Laban sangawngsau van aphel a; sangawngsaute a ding in buhpawl leh gan an apia a, akhe leh alawmte khe silna ding tui apia hi.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

paite: Abraham sikha ma ah nek ding alui a; himahleh ama'n, "Ka hong hohna san thu ka gen mateng ka ne kei ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Gen ve le," achi hi.
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

paite: Ama'n, "Kei Abraham sikha ka hi.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

paite: TOUPA'N ka pu nakpitak in avualzawl a, miliantak ahong hita. TOUPA'N akiang ah belamhon, bawnghon, dangka, dangka-eng, sikhapate, sikhanute, sangawngsaute leh sabiltungte leng apia hi.
english: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

paite: Ka pu zi Sarah in tek nungpi in ka pu a ding in tapa aneihsak a; akiang ah aneih tengteng ape vek hi.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

paite: Ka pu in, ka tenna gam a Kanaante nungak lak a ka tapa zi ding a na neihsak ding ahi kei.
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

paite: Ka pa inn lam ah, ka tanaute kiang ah hoh inla, ka tapa zi na pisak zaw ding ahi, chi in ahon kichiamsak hi."
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

paite: Ke'n ka pu kiang ah, "Numei in hon zui nuam kei kha ding," ka chi hi.
english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

paite: Ama'n, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA ama a ka om zelnapa'n na kiang ah a-angel ahon sawl ding a; na hohna ding ah hon lohchingsak ding. Ka tapa a ding in ka tanaute leh ka pa inkote lak a zi na neisak ding ahi.
english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

paite: Ka tanaute kiang ngei na tun chiang in, ka kiang a na kichiamna a kipan na siang ding. Nungak ahon piak kei uleh ka kiang a na kichiamna a kipan na siang ding," achi hi.
english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

paite: "Tuni in tuikhuk ka hong tung a, 'Aw, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, ka paina a na hon lohchinsak dingleh, en in, tuikhuk kiang ah ka dingh hi.'
english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

paite: Hichi hi henla, tui tawi ding a nungak hong kuan kuapeuh kiang a, 'Hehpih in dawn ding na tuibel a tui tawmchik hon pia in,' ka chih a,
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

paite: ama'n ka kiang a, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute a ding leng ka tawi ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngeingei ka pu tapa a ding a TOUPA numei seh hi hen,' ka chi hi.
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

paite: Ka lungsim a ka gen khit ma in, ngai in, Rebekah, atuibel pua in ahong kuan a; tuikhuk ah apaisuk a; tui atawi a; akiang ah, 'Hehpih in tui hon dawnsak dih ve,' ka na chi hi.
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

paite: Ama'n kintak in aliangzang a kipan tuibel adomkhia a, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding,' achi hi. Ka dawn a, sangawngsaute leng adawnsak hi.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

paite: Ke'n, 'Kua tanu na hia?' chi in ka dong a; ama'n, 'Nahor tapa, Milkah in aneihsakpa Bethuel tanu ka hi,' achi hi. Abil ah bilbah ka batsak a, taute leng akhut ah ka bunsak hi.
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

paite: "Ka lu ka kunsak a, TOUPA ka bia a, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, ka pu sanggampa tanu ngei, atapa a dia azi ding a pisak ding a lampi diktak a hon pipa ka phat hi.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

paite: Tu in ka pu na hehpih ua, atung a chihtak pet a na hih ding uleh hon hilh un. Na hih kei ding uleh leng hon hilh un. Taklam hiam, veilam hiam, ka nga thei ding," achi hi.
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

paite: Laban leh Bethuel in adawng ua, "Hiai thil TOUPA a kipan a pawt ahi. Kou na kiang ah asia-apha bangmah ka gen thei kei uh.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

paite: En in, na ma ah Rebekah a-om, pi inla, paipih in, TOUPA'N agensa bang in na pu tapa zi ding in om hen," achi uh.
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Abraham sikha in athu uh azaktak in lei si in TOUPA abia hi.
english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

paite: Abraham sikha in dangka suang kizepnate, dangka- eng kizepnate leh silh-le-ten alakhia a, Rebekah apia a; asanggampa leh anu kiang ah leng thil manpha pipi apia hi.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

paite: Amah leh alawmte'n ne in adawn ua, huai ah agiakta uh. Zingsang in athou ua, "Ka pu kiang ah hon paisakta un," achi hi.
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

paite: Asanggampa leh anu'n, "Nungak ni sawt lou chik, ni sawm lel bek, ka kiang uah om tadih hen. Huai khit in ahong pai na ding," achi uhi.
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zekaisak kei dih ua, TOUPA'N lah ka hohna ah ahon lohchingsakta ngal a. Ka pu kiang a ka paitheihna ding in, hon sawl zaw mai ve ua,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

paite: Amau, "Nungak ka sam ding ua, ama kam mahmah kidongleh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

paite: Rebekah asam ua akiang ah, "Hiai mipa kiang ah na pai nuam maw?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Pai nuam ve ning e,” achi hi.
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

paite: Asanggamnu uh Rebekah leh adonnu leh Abraham sikha leh amite akhakheta uhi.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

paite: Huan Rebekah avualzawl ua, akiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu uh aw, nang, sing ngenta sang tampite nu hong hi in! Na suante'n amau hote kulh kongkhak neihsak uhen!" achi uhi.
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

paite: Rebekah athou a, asikhanute toh sangawngsaute tung ah atuang ua, huai mi azuita uhi. Abraham sikha in Rebekah api a, apaita uhi.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

paite: Huan Beer-lahai-roi tuikhuk lam a kipan Isak ahong a, amah sim gam a teng ahi.
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

paite: Nitaklam in loubuk ah kingaihtuah ding in Isak apawtkhia hi. Adak a, a-en a, ngai in, sangawngsau hong paite amu hi.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

paite: Rebekah adak a, Isak amuhtak in sangawngsau tung a kipan akumkhia hi.
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

paite: Sikhapa kiang ah, "Gamlak anhon dawn ding a hong pai kua ahia?" achi a; sikha in, "Ka pu ahi,” achi hi. Kikhuhna puan ala a, akikhuhta hi.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

paite: Sikha in athilhih tengteng Isak ahilh hi.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

paite: Isak in anu Sarah puanin ah apilut a, Rebekah ala a, azi ahong hita hi. Amah a-it a, anu sih nung Isak khamuang in a-omta hi.
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
